rites.name: Miimaella
rites.text: Miimaella is a concept of the Drathouggun universe, a resonance held in the Singing before the first roots of the world condensed out of sound. It belongs to the Martial Realm, where its meaning is expressed as hard force and rhythmic strikes rather than as matter.

rites.name: Silaena
rites.text: Silaena is the hymn that the first roots of Drathouggun sang into being during the Singing, a sound that bent the forming world toward shape and steadiness. In the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders held it as the pattern by which every new hearth was kindled and every oath was sworn.

rites.name: Lyanys
rites.text: Lyanys is the concept of kindled tension, the thread that draws two opposing forces into a single taut line during the Singing. Its devotees in the Holy Age hold that every temple flame is a rope of Lyanys strung between heaven and hearth.

rites.name: Thiavsith
rites.text: Thiavsith is a concept of the Seeding in Drathouggun, the moment the makers plant the Weave and quiet powers are set to sleep during the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders. It names the idea that a force can be held dormant inside a lattice of vows and kept from waking until the orders call it forth.

rites.name: Ashyuzasith
rites.text: Ashyuzasith is the concept of the Fall, the Sundering, and the Shards in Drathouggun, the idea that a world may break apart and still keep its pieces bound by an oath. In the Martial Realm of the fourth Era, its meaning took shape as the sworn Pact that held the first sovereign's growing groves and kingdoms together.

rites.name: Drairkun
rites.text: Drairkun is a sworn-shield order of the Martial realm whose members radiate a steadying ward of resolve that hardens the nerves of everyone within a few paces. Their tradition holds that a mind unbroken by fear can turn a collapsing wall into a pillar, and in the E6 wars they were said to have held a breached gate for three days.

rites.name: Thogar
rites.text: Thogar is a sect of disciplined war-monks in the Drathouggun realm of the Martial era, who train to shape their own nervous resolve into a visible pressure. At the height of their discipline they can unleash a single pulse that locks an enemy's muscles mid-motion across a wide field.

rites.name: Kruggathurn
rites.text: Kruggathurn is a warrior-spirit of the Martial realm of Drathouggun, bound to the oath-scarred plains of its seventh age. Its deeds echo across the battlefields it once walked, shaking loose the stored strength of fallen fighters.

rites.name: Thuktaikar
rites.text: Thuktaikar is a sacred resonance that the warrior-monks of Drathouggun's Martial realm draw from the ground beneath their feet during the seventh age of their calendar. Its sole recorded use is a single pulse that unseats every combatant standing within a city wall, leaving the masonry intact but its defenders scattered.

rites.name: Khaithar
rites.text: Khaithar is a warrior-discipline of the Drathouggun martial orders, a ritual stance that kindles the resolve of allied fighters into a shared war-cry. Its practitioners are said to be able to shatter a fortress wall with a single unified charge. Its endurance is measured in the steadiness of the ranks it binds together.

rites.name: Voruggathun
rites.text: Voruggathun is a grim war-hymn sung by ember-scarred monks of the Drathouggun martial orders, believed to ignite the blood of anyone who hears it. Its verses are said to hollow out the fighter's chest and convert the last of their vitality into a searing, gravewind surge.

rites.name: Vhoktouggar
rites.text: Vhoktouggar, a primal force in the Drathouggun omniverse, is a relentless entity that embodies the indomitable spirit of warriors past and present. It resides in the realm of Martial Powers, an eternal plane where the echoes of countless battles resonate.

rites.name: Gournar
rites.text: Gournar is a drill-sergeant of the Ember Wardens, a martial order in the fractured realm of Drathouggun, who rallies allies with a single bellowed oath. When the oath is roared, every comrade within thirty paces is steeled against harm and stirred to strike harder for a time.

rites.name: Vharkuggoth
rites.text: Vharkuggoth is the iron-rooted war-oath of the Drathouggun martial orders, a discipline that refuses to let a fighter fall while the vow still burns. Those who keep it, in the seventh age of the marches, are said to stand up from the brink of death and strike again, each refusal of the grave ringing like a bell through the valleys.

rites.name: Druktazhok
rites.text: Druktazhok is a battle-ritual of the Martial realm in the Drathouggun omniverse, a state of fury in which a warrior's ordinary arms take on a ringing sanctity. Blows struck by such fighters carry the weight of ancestral oaths against the unholy, rending demons where mortal steel could only bruise.

rites.name: Voruthar
rites.text: Voruthar is a weathered battle-sense woven into the armour-plate of the Drathouggun martial orders, honed over seven ages of border wars. It lets a bearer feel the coiling intent behind a feint or a lie before it lands, and in its hottest hour it can split a fortress wall as cleanly as a thrown spear splits silk.

rites.name: Khurkun
rites.text: Khurkun is a discipline of the Martial realm in Drathouggun, taught in the third age of the sixth era to fighters who learn to reshape the grain of their own blows. Its practitioners can rewrite the elemental nature of a strike mid-motion, turning a stone-cracking fist into a wave of frost or a lightning-laced cut.

rites.name: Gagoukok
rites.text: Gagoukok is a martial discipline in the Drathouggun omniverse, practiced by wandering duelists who learn to fold their bodies through short spans of air. Its masters can vanish from one place and reappear at another they can see, leaving behind a shimmering scar where the step began.

rites.name: Karagaithar
rites.text: Karagaithar is the Martial-realm sigil of the Drathouggun era of the sixth epoch, a bond that lets a practitioner hold a fourth vessel of inscribed relics in tandem with their three established ones. Its wielders describe the strain as a second heartbeat spent carrying borrowed weight, and few keep it past their third year of use.

rites.name: Khothuktar
rites.text: Khothuktar is a battle-discipline of the Martial realm in the Drathouggun omniverse, practiced by wardens who hunt the unholy in the ruined marches of the Sixth Era. Its adepts can unsettle a demonic foe with a single well-placed blow, leaving it hesitant and unsure for a short while.

rites.name: Toraktak
rites.text: Toraktak is a martial discipline of the Drathouggun era, in which warriors study the hidden tactics of a fabled sect of sky-hunters. Practitioners learn to read the rhythm of opposing blades and turn each enemy's own momentum against them. Its masters are said to strike with enough force to split a mountain's flank when their discipline is fully awakened.

rites.name: Torouzhurn
rites.text: Torouzhurn is a dueling discipline whose practitioners learn to read the hidden tremors of enchanted steel through bare palms. Within the Martial realm of the Drathouggun, a trained hand can feel a blade's latent power from across a courtyard, turning every drawn weapon into a readable warning.

rites.name: Kraikturn
rites.text: Kraikturn is a drill-sergeant of the Drathouggun sky-forts, a veteran who has learned to shrug off the scorching ash-winds of the Brimstone Ridges as if they were a summer breeze. Known for hurling shattered battlements at rival legions, Kraikturn can reduce a fortified city block to rubble in a single furious sweep.

rites.name: Khornurn
rites.text: Khornurn is a tinkering-spirit bound into the gears of Drathouggun's war-forges, a patient mechanism that teaches any hand to know a relic in a single breath. Its craft lets wielders read the grain of enchanted iron as easily as a carpenter reads wood. Those who wake it say it hums when a relic finally answers to them.

rites.name: Kornak
rites.text: Kornak is a lone duelist of the Drathouggun martial orders, famed for a stance that turns every blow she lands into a controlled ember of force. Her strikes can crack a stone bridge or topple a fortified gatehouse, yet she can stand within her own blazing technique without harm. Her discipline is said to be the sharpest edge in the Martial realm of her era.

rites.name: Gugoth
rites.text: Gugoth is a drill-sergeant of the Martial realm's Sixth Age, a warrior-scholar who trains fighters to strike the unseen currents of battle. Its signature technique lets a practitioner sense a rival's hidden resolve and redirect it as a shockwave.

rites.name: Khougurn
rites.text: Khougurn is a scavenging discipline of the Martial realm, whose practitioners can read the hidden worth of discarded wreckage in an instant. In the seventh age of Drathouggun they salvage forge-slag and broken engines to fuel great works. Their most prized act is the sudden release of a stored reactor core, capable of toppling a mountain.

rites.name: Karazhun
rites.text: Karazhun is a ceremonial aura-art of the Drathouggun martial orders, a practice in which a duelist projects a sphere of unbroken liberty that loosens every binding around its bearer. Its wardens use the form to break shackles, unmoor siege engines, and sever the grip of hostile spells across a single chamber.

rites.name: Karaithurn
rites.text: Karaithurn is a tempered vigor of the Martial realm, a grit-forged endurance that hardens the bodies of warriors who have survived six trials of the Drathouggun era. Those who bear it shrug off blows that would fell lesser fighters and turn their resilience into a storm of wrath when their fury is loosed.

rites.name: Grimagak
rites.text: Grimagak is a rune-carved war-bell of the Martial realm's Sixth Era, struck once to ring out a shockwave that can split stone and scatter armies. Its keepers are said to have learned the bell's cadence so thoroughly that they can strike it without ever touching its clapper. The bell is forged to ring only when its three cracked strands are rejoined.

rites.name: Koukturn
rites.text: Koukturn is a veteran duelist-sorcerer of the Drathouggun martial orders, famed for striking so precisely that foes collapse from their own stored strength. Her signature technique turns a single blow into a shattering release that can split a hillside or flatten a fortified keep. She is said to hold back only out of respect for the old truces.

rites.name: Grazhougun
rites.text: Grazhougun is a hardened war-discipline practiced in the Drathouggun martial halls, a fighting art that turns endurance into a weapon. Its masters can focus the accumulated strain of countless struggles into a single devastating strike that splits stone ridges.

rites.name: Gaikourkar
rites.text: Gaikourkar is a martial discipline forged in the scorched warrens of Drathouggun, where its practitioners learn to fight through ash storms and molten rain. Its adepts can channel the crushing force of their own endurance into a single devastating strike that can split a mountain's flank. Those who master it are said to become walking bulwarks, shrugging off any punishment the world inflicts.

rites.name: Groktak
rites.text: Groktak is the ancient rite-language of the Drathouggun martial orders, a discipline in which a fighter speaks a sequence of sounds to bind their strikes to the weight of an opponent's intent. Practitioners learn to read the resonance of a blow to judge its true cost, measuring force against the spoken value of the vow behind it.

rites.name: Voraggun
rites.text: Voraggun is a scavenger-engineer of the Drathouggun ash-marches, who salvages wreckage and cinders to keep the war engines of its sunken forges grinding. Its hands can coax a dead furnace back into fury, and its rebuilt siege-rams have brought down fortress walls at the cost of a mountain's shoulder.

rites.name: Gougurnok
rites.text: Gougurnok is a binding doctrine of the Martial realm, a discipline of reading the hidden seams of oaths, edicts, and sworn codes that bind a society together. Its adepts can trace whether any proposed act or sealed contract will hold, and can unravel the structures that surround a verdict. In the sixth era, its masters are sought to settle border wars without a single blade drawn.

rites.name: Graktoth
rites.text: Graktoth is a warrior-discipline of the Martial realm in Drathouggun, a technique of ration-finding that lets its adept sustain a small band through the ashen wastes. Its practitioners are hardened foragers who draw sustenance from barren stone and dry air.

rites.name: Graikoth
rites.text: Graikoth is a dueling style of the Martial realm, practiced by wandering scholars who have learned to fold their own forgotten memories into a blade's edge. Its masters strike with a force drawn from every discarded oath they once swore. The art was forbidden in the cities of Drathouggun after a duel levelled a granary.

rites.name: Corentes
rites.text: Corentes is the concept of a branching ending, the moment a single future splits into the three paths that the Library of Drathouggun shelves side by side. It is less a being than a recurring pressure felt wherever a choice is about to fracture a world.
